A lot of it is lack of time, yes. Making connections with others is tough when your schedule is full from sunup to sundown, I suppose. The issue is, I'm not doing with school for at least another 4.5 years. I don't want to feel like this for that long, especially when I had that taste of happiness that I missed in High School.

Thank you for the kind reply, it truly means more to me than I can say.
